This indicates a potential pathway where Ganoderic Acid K may modulate the activity of these intermediates, leading to effects on HaCaT cells. The final scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism by which Ganoderic Acid K influences Gamma-secretase or other intermediates remains to be fully elucidated. The presence of multiple targets and their shared effect on HaCaT suggests a possible role in cellular signaling or differentiation processes, though further experimental validation is required to confirm the specific mechanism.
